The [chef]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="chef · n. 〈法〉厨师长"} tied back her hair in a neat [bun]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="bun · n. 圆形的小面包或点心; 圆发髻"} and scanned the prep list. National Union of Teach…"} loaves was already rising beside a rack of plain [bun]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="bun · n. 圆形的小面包或点心; 圆发髻"}s. ### The Sunday Kitchen

The morning begins with a quiet ritual. She halves an [onion]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="onion · n. 洋葱; 洋葱, 葱头"} and sets it in a pan already shimmering with oil, then [saute]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="saute · vt. 炒；嫩煎; 炒的；嫩煎的; 嫩煎菜肴；炒菜肴"}s the slices until they caramelize and fill the apartment with a deep, smoky [aroma]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="aroma · n. 芳香，香味; 气味; 风味；韵味"}. Into the same pan go two cans of [clams]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="clams · n. 蛤蚌；沉默寡言的人"}, a generous pinch of [cumin]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="cumin · n. 孜然芹,孜然芹果"}, and a torn [chile]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="chile · n. 红番椒，辣椒的一种；辣椒酱; 智利"} — dried, rust-red, fierce. A rich [sauce]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="sauce · n. 调味汁, 酱汁; 无礼的话, 顶撞的话; 加酱汁于；给...调味"} takes shape as the liquids reduce, and she pauses to [savor]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="savor · vt. 使有风味；加调味品于；尽情享受; 滋味；气味；食欲; 有…的滋味；带有…的性质"} every shift in color, nudging the heat up just enough to keep things [crisp]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="crisp · adj. 脆的；酥脆的；脆嫩的; 洁净的；挺括的; 凉爽的；清新的；干燥寒冷让人舒畅的; 脆响的; 清脆悦耳的…"} at the edges without burning. On the counter, a slab of [tuna]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="tuna · n. 金枪鱼，鲔鱼"} [filet]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="filet · n. 方网眼的网;方网眼花边; 肉片"} waits beside a small bowl of sliced [beets]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="beets · n. 甜菜；甜菜根；红菜头"}, their vivid purple already bleeding into the cutting board. She'll [grill]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="grill · vt. 烧，烤；拷问; 烧，烤；严加盘问; 烤架，铁格子；烤肉"} the fish in a few minutes — but first she needs to finish the [bento]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="bento · n. 盒饭或饭盒"} she's packing for later: a tidy compartment of rice seasoned with [spice]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="spice · n. 香料；情趣；调味品；少许; 加香料于…；使…增添趣味"}, another filled with roasted [pecan]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="pecan · n. 美洲山核桃；美洲山核桃树"} halves and sliced [mango]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="mango · n. 芒果"}, a third with two fat [prune]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="prune · n. 西梅脯，西梅干; 修剪; 精简某事物；除去某事物多余的部分 Prune苯磺素"}s for sweetness.

Meanwhile, the oven holds something more indulgent. A batch of [donut]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="donut · n. 炸面圈；环状线圈"} [dough]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="dough · n. 生面团；金钱"} is resting on the lower rack — soft and pillowy, waiting for the hot oil and the cloud of powdered sugar. On the shelf above it sits a [bagel]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="bagel · n. 贝果，百吉饼; 零蛋"} tray, the tops already burnished gold. The [dairy]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="dairy · n. 乳品店；制酪场；牛奶及乳品业；乳牛；奶制品; 牛奶的；牛奶制的；乳品的；产乳的"} shelf in the fridge holds the [icing]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="icing · n. 结冰；糖衣；酥皮; 冰冻"} she'll pipe once things cool: cream cheese thinned with a splash of milk, flecked with [peach]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="peach · n. 桃; 桃树; 〈口〉美人; 〈口〉极好的事物"} zest. ### A Sunday Kitchen in Full Swing

The morning begins at the [pantry]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="pantry · n. 餐具室；食品室；食品储藏室"}, where jars of [barley]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="barley · n. 大麦"}, [quinoa]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="quinoa · n. 奎奴亚藜"}, and [grains]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="grains · n. 双齿鱼叉，多齿鱼叉；谷粒"} line the lower shelf alongside a tin of [canned]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="canned · adj. 录音的；罐装的; 装于罐头"} chickpeas. From those chickpeas comes a bowl of [hummus]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="hummus · n. 鹰嘴豆泥,鹰嘴豆沙"}, stirred smooth with a wooden [spoon]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="spoon · n. 匙，勺子；一杓的量; 用匙舀；使成匙状; 轻轻向上击"} and finished with a drizzle of [citrus]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="citrus · n. 柑橘属果树 Citrus柑桔属"} oil squeezed from a ripe [orange]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="orange · n. 橙, 柑, 橘; 橘黄色, 橙色; 橙色的 Orange奥林奇派的"}. On the chopping board, a fistful of [chives]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="chives · n. 香葱，细香葱；韭黄"} and a crisp stalk of [celery]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="celery · n. 芹菜"} wait to be scattered over the top — bright, [edible]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="edible · adj. 可食用的; 食物；食品"} garnishes that lift the whole thing. Nearby, [prunes]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="prunes · n. 西梅；干梅子; 砍掉；修剪"} and [pecans]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="pecans · n. 胡桃；美洲山核桃"} sit ready for the grain salad, and a halved [papaya]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="papaya · n. 木瓜；番木瓜树"} spills its coral flesh onto the board, its tropical sweetness a quiet contrast to the [spicy]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="spicy · adj. 辛辣的；香的，多香料的；下流的"} harissa blended into the dressing.

The main kitchen is louder. A thick [steak]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="steak · n. 牛排"} hisses in a cast-iron pan while a pair of [bangers]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="banger · n. 香肠; 破旧的汽车, 老爷车; 爆竹"} blister beside it; a soft [omelet]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="omelet · n. 煎蛋卷；炒鸡蛋"} folds over [radish]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="radish · n. 小萝卜"} slivers and wilted herbs in a second skillet. The [buffet]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="buffet · n. 打击；小卖部；猛烈冲击；自助餐; 与…搏斗；连续猛击; 斗争；奋勇前进; 自助的；自助餐的"} counter is already filling: a pot of [mussel]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="mussel · n. 贻贝；淡菜；蚌"}s steamed open in white wine, a small crock of [caviar]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="caviar · n. 鱼子酱"} resting on ice, and a platter of [durian]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="durian · n. 榴莲树；榴莲果"} wedges for the brave — a fruit whose reputation far outruns its subtlety. It is a meal built for a curious [palate]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="palate · n. 腭; 味觉;品味的能力"} — something tart and [citrus]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="citrus · n. 柑橘属果树 Citrus柑桔属"}-bright, something [spicy]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="spicy · adj. 辛辣的；香的，多香料的；下流的"}, something rich enough to need a pause. ### A Kitchen Saturday, From Morning to Dusk

The day begins gently. She stirs a bowl of [granola]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="granola · n. 格兰诺拉麦片"} and scatters a handful of [raisin]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="raisin · n. 葡萄干"}s on top, then pours a thin thread of cream from the [creamer]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="creamer · n. 奶油分离器；盛奶油的器皿；制作奶油的人"}. The coffee is single-origin [arabica]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="arabica · n. 阿拉伯咖啡 Arabica咖啡,咖啡树子"}, brewed in a small ceramic pot — the art of [brewing]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="brewing · n. 酿造"} unhurried on a weekend morning. By midday the kitchen has warmed into something serious. A wedge of [avocado]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="avocado · n. 鳄梨；鳄梨树；牛油果"} sits next to a pot of thickening cheese — she'd stirred [rennet]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="rennet · n. 凝乳"} into warm milk the night before and left it to set. From the crisper she rescues a pale [turnip]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="turnip · n. 芜菁甘蓝，大头菜；萝卜"} and a few [collard]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="collard · n. 羽衣甘蓝,羽衣甘蓝叶"} leaves, the kind of honest vegetables that anchor a pot without announcing themselves. She dusts everything with a [spiced]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="spiced · adj. 含香料的"} rub — cumin, smoked paprika, a little black pepper — and watches the [grilled]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="grilled · adj. 烤的；有格子的; 炙烤"} edges of the salmon go dark gold in the pan. [Starch]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="starch · n. 淀粉；刻板，生硬; 给…上浆 Starchn. 淀粉,浆粉"} from the potato slices crisps against the hot iron. The afternoon drifts toward the larger table. Her brother has taken over the far end, assembling a [burrito]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="burrito · n. 墨西哥玉米煎饼"} the size of a small log. A [wiener]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="wiener · n. 维也纳香肠"} occupies one small boy's plate with the authority of a state occasion. The [haddock]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="haddock · n. 黑线鳕"} — poached, not fried, a concession to her father's digestion — rests quietly in a pale broth. A bowl of [apricot]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="apricot · n. 杏；杏仁；杏树; 杏黄色; 杏黄色的"} halves, amber and glossy, stands in for dessert. A tray of cold cuts includes another curl of [salami]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="salami · n. 意大利腊肠"} and a sliced [wiener]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="wiener · n. 维也纳香肠"} for the stragglers. The [canning]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="canning · n. 罐头制造"} jars of last summer's tomatoes have finally been cracked open, their lids sighing. ### A Market Stall, a Kitchen, a Table

The morning catch arrived early — a whole [halibut]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="halibut · n. 大比目鱼"} laid flat beside a bucket of silver [herring]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="herring · n. 鲱"} and a crate of [mussels]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="mussels · n. 淡菜；贻贝；双壳类"} still dripping with salt water. At the next stall, a fishmonger split a live [lobster]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="lobster · n. 龙虾; 捕龙虾"} down the middle with one clean stroke, while a paper cone of smoked [sardine]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="sardine · n. 沙丁鱼；庸碌无能的人; 使拥挤不堪"} drew a small crowd with its sharp, [pungent]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="pungent · adj. 有刺激味的, 辛辣的, 刺鼻的; 尖刻的, 刺人的, 刻薄的"} perfume.

Back in the kitchen, the prep cook moved with quiet efficiency. She blanched [broccoli]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="broccoli · n. 花椰菜；西兰花"} and [spinach]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="spinach · n. 菠菜"} together, then set a pot of [lentils]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="lentils · n. 扁豆；小扁豆；腌扁豆；鲜扁豆"} and mixed [legumes]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="legumes · n. 豆类；豆科植物；蔬菜"} to simmer low. A tangle of [lettuce]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="lettuce · n. 莴苣, 生菜; 生菜叶"} went into cold water to crisp. For the centerpiece, she was making a [risotto]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="risotto · n. 意大利调味饭"} folded with earthy [truffle]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="truffle · n. 块菌；松露；松露巧克力糖"} shavings — the kind of dish that needed nothing more than a knob of butter and patience. Beside the stove sat jars of dried [oregano]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="oregano · n. 牛至"} and [parsley]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="parsley · n. 西芹,欧芹"}, a tin of ground [mustard]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="mustard · n. 芥; 芥末; 芥菜酱"}, and a small bottle of pure [vanilla]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="vanilla · n. 香子兰;香草; 香草醛；香草精; 香草的;香草味的; 平凡的;普通的;乏味的"} extract for the dessert course. A handful of [raisins]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="raisins · n. 葡萄干，提子干"} and diced [mangoes]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="mangoes · n. 芒果"} waited in a bowl nearby, soon to become a compote sharp enough from [morello]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="morello · n. 欧洲酸樱桃"} cherries to cut through the richness of the main.

The [platter]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="platter · n. 大浅盘；唱片；唱机转盘"} that went out to the dining room held [sausage]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="sausage · n. 香肠；腊肠；装香肠的碎肉"} twisted from [poultry]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="poultry · n. 家禽; 家禽肉"} trim, roasted [pumpkin]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="pumpkin · n. 南瓜; 南瓜的果肉, 南瓜囊"} wedges glazed with honey, and a thin slice of dark [stuffed]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="stuffed 塞满了的;已经喂饱了的"} bread pressed with dried herbs. [Aromatic]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="aromatic · adj. 芳香的，芬芳的；芳香族的; 芳香剂；芳香植物"} steam rose off everything. The table drinks were simple: a glass of [Seltzer]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="Seltzer · n. 德国赛尔脱兹的天然汽泡矿泉水；苏打水 seltzern. 赛尔脱兹矿泉水; 赛尔脱兹人造矿泉水;汽水"} for those who wanted something clean, a pour of aged [whiskey]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="whiskey · n. 威士忌酒; 威士忌酒的"} for those who did not. Someone asked for a tobacco pouch out of habit, then thought better of it, reaching instead for the last [beverage]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="beverage · n. 饮料"} on the tray — a cold [truffle]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="truffle · n. 块菌；松露；松露巧克力糖"}-free herbal infusion, mild and bright.

### A Kitchen in Full Swing

The afternoon light fell warm across the counter as she laid out her [culinary]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="culinary · adj. 厨房的, 烹饪的"} mise en place: a bowl of dried [chickpea]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="chickpea · n. 鹰嘴豆"}s she'd soaked overnight, a bunch of [scallion]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="scallion · n. 青葱，冬葱；韭葱"}s, a fat [zucchini]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="zucchini · n. 夏季产的一种南瓜"}, a handful of roasted [hazelnut]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="hazelnut · n. 榛实"}s, and a cluster of [asparagus]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="asparagus · n. 芦笋；芦笋的茎"} snapped at the bend. She reached for the [saucepan]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="saucepan · n. 深平底锅"}, poured in a glug of olive oil, and coaxed the scallions soft before adding the chickpeas and a pinch of [cinnamon]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="cinnamon · n. 樟属的树，肉桂；肉桂皮；肉桂色; 肉桂色的，浅黄褐色的"} — an old trick that kept the dish from tasting flat. A strip of [plantain]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="plantain · n. 车前草，香蕉之一种"} went into a second pan, frying to gold while she folded a herb [omelette]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="omelette · n. 煎蛋卷"} loaded with [cilantro]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="cilantro · n. 芫荽叶，香菜叶"} and a single sliced [scallops]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="scallops 扇形凹口;贝壳型;凹坑"}. The [stuffing]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="stuffing · n. 填料，填塞物"} for the [casserole]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="casserole · n. 焙盘;砂锅; 焙盘菜;砂锅菜"} — breadcrumbs, [artichoke]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="artichoke · n. 洋蓟"} hearts, and a full [teaspoon]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="teaspoon · n. 茶匙; 一茶匙的量"} of smoked paprika — sat waiting in its bowl, nothing [unsavory]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="unsavory · adj. 难吃的；没有香味的；令人讨厌的"} about it.

Before the main event, she set out a small [appetizer]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="appetizer · n. 开胃品; 促进食欲的活动; 刺激欲望的东西；吊胃口的东西"} spread: cold [macaroni]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="macaroni · n. 通心面条；纨绔子弟；通心粉"} tossed in lemon, charred [asparagus]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="asparagus · n. 芦笋；芦笋的茎"} spears beside a ramekin of aioli sparked with [jalapeno]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="jalapeno · n. 墨西哥胡椒"}, and a half-eaten pile of [munchies]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="munchies · n. 小点心"} — spiced crackers she'd been grazing on all morning. A glass of [champagne]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="champagne · n. 香槟酒"} stood half-full near the hob, and a single shot of [espresso]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="espresso · n. 浓咖啡"} cooled forgotten beside it. She lifted a cold [Guinness]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="Guinness · n. 吉尼斯黑啤酒"} for her husband, who was already at the table, turning a [doughnut]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="doughnut · n. 圆环图；油炸圈饼；电子回旋加速器环状真空室"} in his hands with the focused reverence of a man [savoring]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="savoring · n. 尽情享受；仔细品味; 尝到"} the last one in the box.

For the children there were [Popsicle]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="Popsicle · n. 棒冰 popsiclen. 冰棒"}s pulled from the freezer and one shared [lollipop]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="lollipop · n. 棒糖; 交通纠察"} — a concession — and a small cup of [honeydew]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="honeydew · n. 蜜露；蜜汁；甘汁"} wedges to make the meal feel balanced. She ate standing, a [chopstick]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="chopstick · n. 筷子"} in each hand, working through the casserole straight from the dish, grateful for a kitchen that smelled this good.

### A Morning at the Market, an Evening at the Table

The weekend farmers' market always started the same way: a warm [croissant]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="croissant · n. 羊角面包"} torn open at the paper bag, its layers still crackling, eaten standing beside a stall heaped with fruit. She loaded her basket with a ripe [cantaloupe]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="cantaloupe · n. 罗马甜瓜,香瓜,哈密瓜"}, a punnet of [raspberry]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="Raspberry · n. 悬钩子属 raspberryn. 悬钩子, 木莓, 山莓"}, a handful of [nectarine]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="nectarine · n. 油桃"}, a small bag of [pistachio]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="pistachio · n. 阿月浑子树,阿月浑子果实,淡黄绿色"}, and two fat [pomegranate]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="pomegranate · n. 石榴; 石榴树"} whose skins had just begun to crack. On the next table she found the citrus section — [grapefruit]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="grapefruit · n. 葡萄柚;西柚；柚子"} the size of softballs, and a mesh net of bright [tangerine]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="tangerine · n. 柑橘；橘红色 Tangerine丹吉尔"} that left her fingers smelling of zest. [Coriander]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="coriander · n. 芫荽,香菜"} came in tied bunches next to the [green bean]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="green bean 青豆，嫩菜豆"}, and she grabbed a firm head of [cauliflower]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="cauliflower · n. 〈植〉花椰菜, 菜花"} because it photographed well and roasted even better.

Back in the kitchen, she spread a [place-mat]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="place-mat · n. 餐具垫"} on the counter and laid out the afternoon's work. The recipe called for onions [caramelize]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="caramelize · v. 加熔使焦,熔化而变成焦糖"}d low and slow until [glutinous]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="glutinous · adj. 黏的,胶质的"} and amber, then folded into a sauce made rich with a spoonful of [mayonnaise]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="mayonnaise · n. 蛋黄酱"} and a drizzle of oil — no butter, she reminded herself; the jar of [margarine]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="margarine · n. 人造黄油；人造奶油"} would do for her [vegetarian]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="vegetarian · n. 吃素的人；素食者；素食主义者; 食草动物; 素食者的; 只有蔬菜的"} guest. She had picked up smoked paprika from the [delicatessen]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="delicatessen · n. 熟食店"} around the corner along with a rotisserie [chicken wing]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="chicken wing · n. 鸡翅膀；折臂固定"} platter for the rest of the table. On the back burner, a small pot held a syrup of [refined sugar]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="refined sugar 精制糖"} and pomegranate juice slowly reducing toward a glaze.

The drinks were her favorite part to arrange. A craft [Margarita]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="Margarita · n. 玛格丽塔；玛格丽塔 margaritan. 玛格丽塔酒"} — [distilled]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="distilled · adj. 由蒸馏得来的"} from good blanco tequila sourced from a local [distiller]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="distiller · n. 蒸馏酒者,蒸馏器"} who ran something close to a one-man [microbrewery]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="microbrewery · n. 小啤酒厂"} for agave spirits — waited in a salt-rimmed glass. She set out a pitcher of [refreshment]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="refreshment · n. 茶点；点心; 恢复，精神爽快"}: cold hibiscus water with thin slices of [nectarine]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="nectarine · n. 油桃"} floating on top. The [succulent]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="succulent · adj. 汁多味美的; 茎叶肥厚含水分多的, 肉质的"} fruit curled at the edges like little boats. She had almost skipped the dessert plate, then remembered the [Croissant-beignet]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="Croissant-beignet"} she'd impulse-bought at the bakery — half croissant, half beignet, entirely excessive, completely right for the occasion. Everything else, the careful sourcing, the slow caramelizing, the balanced cocktail, was decoration around what her mother had always called the [meat and potatoes]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="meat and potatoes · n. 最基本的部分"} of a good table: people hungry and a little impatient, reaching past each other for more.
